Townhouse for Rent in Arabian Ranches 3

Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this 3-bedroom + maid’s townhouse in Arabian Ranches 3, ideally located on the park and within walking distance to key community amenities.

This well-positioned unit offers a bright and spacious layout, perfect for families seeking a peaceful lifestyle with everything nearby.

Property Features:

 3 Bedrooms
 Maid’s Room
 Spacious Living & Dining Area
 Private Garden
 Covered Parking
 Park Facing Unit
 Vacant / Ready to Move


Community Features:

 Walking distance to Swimming Pool & Gym
 Close to Supermarket & Community Center
 Access to BBQ Areas & Kids Play Areas
 Landscaped parks and walking tracks
 Family-friendly gated community


This property offers the perfect balance of location, lifestyle, and convenience in one of Dubai’s most in-demand communities.
